user_query: My family and I are planning a road trip and we want to create a collaborative playlist. Can you recommend popular songs from the HOT 100 chart? Also, fetch the lyrics for the top 5 songs from the search results. Additionally, find an album related to one of the recommended songs and provide its details.

TaskList.description: 查询当前HOT 100排行榜的热门歌曲
获取排行榜前五首歌曲的歌词
查找与推荐歌曲之一相关的专辑信息
